name: ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON

achievements.name: Armored Core
achievements.description: Unlocked all achievements.

achievements.name: The Perfect Mercenary
achievements.description: Clear all missions with an S Rank rating (via Mission Replay after the story).

achievements.name: Stargazer
achievements.description: Clear all missions (requires three playthroughs to access every mission).

achievements.name: Master of Arena
achievements.description: Clear all Arena programs (across the base game, New Game+ and New Game++).

achievements.name: Asset Holder
achievements.description: Obtain all parts (unlocks after the weapon, external, internal and expansion collector achievements).

achievements.name: Tuning Expert
achievements.description: Perform all OS Tuning upgrades (needs enough OST Chips from Arena).

achievements.name: The Fires of Raven
achievements.description: Reach the ending 'The Fires of Raven' (route 2 - one of three mutually exclusive endings).

achievements.name: Liberator of Rubicon
achievements.description: Reach the ending 'Liberator of Rubicon' (route 3 - one of three mutually exclusive endings).

achievements.name: Alea Iacta Est
achievements.description: Reach the ending 'Alea Iacta Est' (route 1 - one of three mutually exclusive endings).

achievements.name: Weapon Collector
achievements.description: Obtain all weapon parts (every R-Arm, L-Arm, R-Back and L-Back unit).

achievements.name: External Parts Collector
achievements.description: Obtain all frame parts (every Head, Core, Arms and Legs).

achievements.name: Internal Parts Collector
achievements.description: Obtain all inner parts (every Booster, FCS and Generator).

achievements.name: Expansion Collector
achievements.description: Obtain all four Core Expansions (bought with OST Chips in OS Tuning).

achievements.name: Combat Log Collector
achievements.description: Obtain all combat logs (dropped by specific enemy ACs during missions).

achievements.name: Data Log Collector
achievements.description: Obtain ten data logs (collected during missions).

achievements.name: Testing Complete
achievements.description: Clear all combat aptitude evaluation programs in the Arena (in your first playthrough).

achievements.name: Illegal Entry
achievements.description: Clear the mission 'Illegal Entry' (the first mission).

achievements.name: Operation Wallclimber
achievements.description: Clear the mission 'Operation Wallclimber' (Chapter 1).

achievements.name: Contact
achievements.description: Clear the mission 'Attack the Watchpoint' (the final Chapter 1 mission).

achievements.name: Ocean Crossing
achievements.description: Clear the mission 'Ocean Crossing' (the final Chapter 2 mission).

achievements.name: A New Threat
achievements.description: Clear the mission 'Attack the Old Spaceport' (Chapter 3).

achievements.name: Ayre and the Coral
achievements.description: Clear the mission 'Destroy the Ice Worm' (the final Chapter 3 mission).

achievements.name: Into Unknown Territory
achievements.description: Clear the mission 'Underground Exploration - Depths 3' (Chapter 4).

achievements.name: Re-education
achievements.description: Clear the mission 'Reach the Coral Convergence' (the final Chapter 4 mission).

achievements.name: The Floating City
achievements.description: Clear the mission 'Take the Uninhabited Floating City' (Chapter 5).

achievements.name: MIA
achievements.description: Clear the mission 'MIA' (New Game++ only).

achievements.name: Training Complete
achievements.description: Clear all training programs (from the Sortie menu).

achievements.name: Hardware Engineer
achievements.description: Assembled an AC.

achievements.name: Software Engineer
achievements.description: Upgraded your AC's OS.

achievements.name: Graphic Designer
achievements.description: Changed the coloration of your AC.
